title: Hino 4x4high tensile polished alloy Bullbar #7
description: Hino 300 4x4 hi-tensile Alloy Bullbar with heavy duty box uprights and extra heavy duty 10mm thick pressed hi-tensile aluminium main channel. Features full length heavy duty box uprights and lower main protection. Heavy duty backing plate with 38mm tow pin. LED indicator lights are mounted in the outer box uprights. The main pipes are 76mm diameter heavy wall hi-tensile aluminium.
